title: Sleeps 20! 7 bdrm Scottsdale gem Heated Pool & Spa
description:
***Heated Pool & Spa* | 7BR Scottsdale Retreat | Sleeps 20***

Spacious Scottsdale getaway, designed for large families, friend groups, golf trips, and extended stays. This 7-bedroom, 4-bath home offers 3,530 sq ft of comfortable living space, a huge private backyard, and a heated pool & spa—perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring.

Close to Kierland Commons and Scottsdale Quarter, top golf courses, Old Town Scottsdale, hiking trails, and world-class dining and nightlife.
